{{Quote|Welcome to Narmle. The name's Biribas Tarun and I'm in charge of security. For the most part things are pretty quiet around here, which makes Rori very attractive to smugglers. I spend most of my time encouraging them to go elsewhere. If you're looking for assignments, I could sure use your help. What do you say?|Biribas Tarun to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Biribas Tarun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was in charge of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle's]] security, a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he assigned a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] a number of tasks.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Biribas Tarun was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
